channel.title: Ink & Irony
channel.description: Ink on screen, irony in mind.

item.title: Faded Paint
item.description: The female body is a somewhat foolish chemical recording device. Every time she opens the gate to a new man, glue called oxytocin is poured into her brain!!

item.title: The Economics of Female Desire?
item.description: Why does a woman abandon all her standards for the man she desires, yet put up a thousand barriers for an ordinary man?

item.title: Quote of the Day
item.description: ❝Let the world go to hell 🔥🌍, but I must always have my cup of coffee. ☕🖤❞ – Anonymous

item.title: Why Does a Woman Show Off Her Body?
item.description: The body itself was never the problem. The problem has always been the consciousness that inhabits it.

item.title: The Visit
item.description: Where did you come in from? And how did you find your way to me, when my face is as cold and expressionless as any wall?…

item.title: She will never forget…
item.description: You fool, who still believes that a woman is a book you can open and close whenever you please, listen well…

item.title: After the Ball
item.description: Ivan was a young man living the happiest days of his life. One evening, he attended a lavish ball. There, he fell in love with a beautiful girl named Varenka…

item.title: The Illusion of Regret
item.description: Regret… the biggest trick the mind believes. You think you are suffering because of what you did. You think it is the past that hurts you. But the past no longer exists.

item.title: Waiting for Someone
item.description: You are waiting for someone who is not coming back. Meaning, you are living your life in the hope that one day, someone will realize that they cannot live without you. That is not how realization works.

item.title: Che Guevara: Indignation
item.description: “If you tremble with indignation at every injustice then you are a comrade of mine.” — Che Guevara

item.title: Hasta siempre
item.description: Hasta siempre

item.title: Lao Tzu: Present Moment
item.description: “If you are depressed you are living in the past. If you are anxious you are living in the future. If you are at peace you are living in the present.” — Lao Tzu

item.title: Anonymous: Right Path
item.description: “When looking back makes you never want to turn around, rest assured… you're on the right path.” — Anonymous

item.title: The Resting Boat
item.description: The journey had weighed heavily upon it, and it bowed. It was not surrender…

item.title: The Transient Woman
item.description: The Transient Woman essay card.

item.title: Fragment: One-sided things
item.description: One-sided things are always painful… Like when you are waiting while she is sleeping.

item.title: Her Handbag
item.description: I don’t know how she carries an entire home inside a small handbag…

item.title: My Birthday
item.description: You still ask me about my birthday? Then write down what you do not yet know...

item.title: Reflection: October 1st
item.description: October 1st… Another year comes full circle.

item.title: The Poem Is Born from Her Fingers
item.description: I was born… on the twenty-ninth of September...

item.title: Anonymous: Accompany Autumn
item.description: “Accompany autumn on its journey, so that everything life has broken inside you may fall away…” — Anonymous

item.title: Giving Birth on a Yellow Bed
item.description: On the day I was born, September 29, 1983, in one of the old houses of Damascus...
